delivery_role_note: Bounded share-safe-link review surface for an official voter-information route whose current URL may be bookmarked, copied, forwarded, or revisited later.
history_state_alignment_note: The visible URL/history entry is reviewed to stay aligned with the controlling answer state rather than leaving the route trapped in hidden single-tab app state.
safe_record_or_reference_fallback_note: When the current URL is not safely forwardable, the voter is told to keep the reference number and first-party re-entry/help route instead.
sensitive_parameter_policy_note: Shareable URLs for this route must not contain secrets, personal identifiers, or one-time access tokens.
session_bound_url_policy_note: If a personalized signed-in route is revisitable only by the same voter, that boundary is stated explicitly and the office provides a first-party re-entry path.
share_forwarding_note: Copy/share instructions distinguish between a link safe to forward and a route safe only for the same voter after re-authentication.
share_safe_link_surface_label: Example bookmark/share/revisit posture for an official voter-information route
share_safe_url_required_note: Yes — this route expects the voter or a helper to keep or revisit the URL itself as part of the current official record.
